knownDifferences: Data only: all clients, keywords, articles, outlets, journalists and accounts are fictional seed data.
Database schema is a reconstruction from code (column names and types inferred), not the production schema.
notVerified: No real screenshot of the deployed Prism exists to compare against (prism-five-psi.vercel.app returns 404 and Notion had no cover), so the screens are verified only as the original code running, not against a past production capture.
Dark theme not captured (theme setting was System on a light host).

limitations: Deployment https://prism-five-psi.vercel.app (repo homepage) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-03, and the app requires a Supabase login, so the original repo was run locally against a local Supabase with demo data.

Streaming progress: commit 2a6a3f4 added an SSE collector whose server emitted progress events (collecting, fetching_meta, done per keyword), but the client page never rendered the progress object, and commit 737159b replaced SSE with a plain JSON POST. At HEAD the only progress UI is the 수집 중... button state with spinning icons, which is what collecting.png shows. No per-keyword progress screen exists in any commit to capture.
Real Naver news collection and article meta scraping (매체명, 기자명) were not executed because they need NAVER_CLIENT_ID and NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET; the extracted fields shown are seeded values.

screens.origin: src/app/(pages)/clients/[id]/page.tsx, route /clients/<id> with keyword 한결제약 selected (collected news table: 게재일, 매체명, 헤드라인, 기자명, 제목언급)
